title: Constructed tensor realization for an intrinsic Hom presentation
statement: Let X be a scheme and B a finite commutative ring. Given a normalized intrinsic tensor-Hom presentation a [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models], restrict a.representative along the inclusion of termwise flat K-flat complexes into the independent-coefficient K-flat class. This gives a ProEtaleTensorModel with tensor a.tensor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Apply the specified finiteScalarTensorRealization [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-realization], invert its components, and uncurry. The constructed natural isomorphism mu has components a.tensor(FK,FL) isomorphic to F(K tensor L), where F is the canonical derived constant-scalar realization. Its data come from the existing normalized construction, not from an existence statement about biduality.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 07A4 and 0FPT; sites.tex Tag 00YV. The second paragraph of literature/blueprint/latest/blueprint/sec-smooth-purity/sk-lem-sp-tower/thm-coef-integral-verdier.proof.md, identifying the finite evaluation transpose.

proof.text: A termwise flat K-flat complex is independent-coefficient K-flat by isKFlatIndependentCoefficients_iff_isKFlat. Whisker a.representative with this inclusion in both variables. Keep a.tensor as the tensor field.

Apply finiteScalarTensorRealization to that tensor model. Define mu(K,L) as the inverse of its (K,L) component. Naturality in each curried variable gives naturality in a pair by factoring (f,g) as (f,id) followed by (id,g). The inverse is already supplied by the natural isomorphism.

def finiteIntrinsicTensorRealization (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X (proEtaleConstantRing X B)) :
    (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor.prod
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor ⋙ a.tensor ≅
      Functor.uncurry.obj (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _) ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor
